title: Stage 2 Mixture-of-Experts Adversarial Assessment: Trusted Types CSP Safety, Bounded Storage LRU & YouTube SPA Observer Hardening

findings.title: AUD-03: Direct this.ttsRateBtn.innerHTML = '' DOM sink violated YouTube Trusted Types CSP
findings.resolution: Replaced with clearEl(this.ttsRateBtn) cleanly; added unit test #28 asserting zero .innerHTML / .outerHTML / insertAdjacentHTML / document.write sinks anywhere in youtube-feed-summariser.user.js.

findings.title: AUD-01: Persistent GM storage alt_title:*, draft:*, and response_ratings grew unboundedly and touchCacheIndex stalled eviction when open windows were present
findings.resolution: Enforced bounded LRU indices (alt_title_index cap 500, draft_index cap 200, response_ratings cap 500), fixed touchCacheIndex() iteration over sorted evictable keys while preserving open windows, and verified 505-entry LRU eviction in Suite 2.

findings.title: Context menu video ID extraction trusted cached card.dataset.ytaisVideoId ahead of live DOM href
findings.resolution: Updated menu extraction to resolve live getCardVideoId(card) first before falling back to dataset.ytaisVideoId, eliminating stale ID confusion on recycled SPA cards.

roadmapReview.notes: Stage 3 accessibility & non-blocking Shadow DOM toast migration (replacing alert() and adding top/keyboard resize ergonomics) cleanly follows Stage 2 CSP & storage hardening.

findings.title: AUD-02: Unfiltered MutationObserver on document.body triggered periodic rescans on player timer / live-chat characterData and self-mutated .yt-alt-title-btn icons
findings.resolution: Implemented isFeedMutationRelevant() filtering player/live-chat subtrees, made updateSwitchButtonUI() idempotent via ytaisBtnMode/title checks, and added _ytaisSelfMutatedTs echo guard; verified 0 scans during noise mutations in Check 43d.

findings.title: Batch alt-title generation lacked per-model HTTP 429 cooldown circuit breaker and decorrelated jitter backoff
findings.resolution: Added modelCooldowns Map + computeDecorrelatedJitterDelay() + multi-flash failover loop in generateAlternativeTitle(); verified in unit test #26 and Check 43e.

roadmapReview.notes: Stage 3 listener tracking cleanup on resize handles (_interactionCleanup) and CI simulator regression spec in run_all_tests.js remain critical stability steps before Stage 4 modularization.

roleReviews.roleTitle: UX, Visual Layout & Spec Compliance Critic

findings.title: AUD-04: Processed YouTube feed cards kept stale _originalTitle / _aiTitle / badge buttons on SPA node recycling and ignored /shorts/<id> URLs
findings.resolution: Extended getCardVideoId() for /shorts/ and /live/ URLs ({8,32}), added resetRecycledFeedCardState() stripping stale badges and '[AI Summary Title]' tooltips when card videoId changes; verified in Check 43b & 43c.

findings.title: Live Chromium verification of 1.5x TTS rate badge rendering and SPA dock restore after Stage 2 edits
findings.resolution: Verified cleanly in live Chromium r4-stage2-spa-stress.png with 0 console errors or warnings.

roadmapReview.notes: Stages 3-5 roadmap sequence (A11y/Keyboard/CI parity -> Modular React/Userscript zero-drift + FEAT-01..03 -> Long-video chunking & export bundles) stays coherent and ready.
